text.tspan: Income share of the richest 10% before and after tax2024
The share of income received by the richest 10% of the population. Income is measured before taxes on the
horizontal axis and after taxes on the vertical axis.
Income share of the richest 10% before tax
Income share of the richest 10% after tax
Note: Before tax income is measured before payment of taxes and non-pension benefits, but after the payment of public and private pensions.
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2034 is shown instead.
